info.title: Your Move API
info.description: The public HTTP API. Everything is under /api/v1; changes within v1 are additive only.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-sid
sessionCookie.description: The session cookie set by `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify` (`sid` in local-dev mode, 06 §4).

operatorContact.description: How to reach the instance operator.

privacyRetention.description: The operator's statement of how long logs, backups and the email provider's copies of sent messages are kept (PRIVACY_RETENTION), for the privacy page; absent when not set.

vapidPublicKey.description: Web Push application server key, when push is configured.

turnstileSiteKey.description: Turnstile site key, when Turnstile is enabled.

uploadsEnabled.description: Whether players may upload word lists (DICTIONARY_UPLOADS).

email.description: The address to sign in with. Normalised by the server.

ageAttested.description: Whether the age confirmation for the current MIN_AGE is given.

needsOnboarding.description: True until onboarding is complete, and again after a `MIN_AGE` rise until the age is confirmed again (06 §5); gated endpoints answer 403 until then.

isAdmin.description: Lets the client show admin links; grants nothing.

whoCanAddMe.description: Who can add me to games (06 §6.2).

emailNudges.description: Email me "It's your turn" after a game has waited 24 hours for me, at most once a day per game (03 §7). Off by default.

theme.description: Colour theme: "system" follows the device, "light" and "dark" override it (07 §5). "system" by default.

email.description: The address to sign in with. Normalised by the server.

code.description: The 8-digit code from the email; spaces and dashes are ignored.

revokeTokens.description: Also revoke every API token of the user and their AI accounts (06 §4).

displayName.description: 1–24 characters; no links, addresses, long digit runs or reserved words (06 §5.1). Onboarding completes once both this and `ageAttested` are given, in one request or two (06 §5); after that, a change is a rename.

ageAttested.description: The user confirms they are at least `minAge` (`GET /api/v1/config`): records the time and the `MIN_AGE` in force, or changes nothing while the current `MIN_AGE` is already confirmed (06 §5). Onboarding completes once both this and a display name are given, in one request or two; a user re-prompted after a `MIN_AGE` rise sends it alone.

emailNudges.description: Email me "It's your turn" after a game has waited 24 hours for me, at most once a day per game (03 §7). Off by default.

theme.description: Colour theme: "system" follows the device, "light" and "dark" override it (07 §5). "system" by default.

code.description: The 8-digit code from the email; spaces and dashes are ignored.

endpoint.description: The subscription's endpoint: an `https` URL at an allow-listed push service (08 T12), as `PushSubscription.endpoint` gives it.

p256dh.description: Unpadded base64url of the 65-byte uncompressed P-256 public key.

auth.description: Unpadded base64url of the 16-byte auth secret.

endpoint.description: The subscription's endpoint: an `https` URL at an allow-listed push service (08 T12), as `PushSubscription.endpoint` gives it.

icon.description: Sanitised SVG markup (02 §7.2). Render it only as an image from a `data:` URL, never inline.

defaults.description: The option input the new-game form starts from: your last options for this type if they still resolve, otherwise `{}` (module defaults).

catalog.description: The module's catalog: its own schema (02 §2).

joinLinkUrl.description: The join link asked for with `joinLink`, shown only here: `PUBLIC_URL/join#<token>`.

options.description: The module's option input. Omitted top-level keys are filled from your last options for this type (05 §Remembered options).

seats.description: Seat count within the module's `players(options)`; default max if min = max, else min.

turnTimeoutDays.description: Whole days, 1–30 (`INVALID_TIMEOUT` otherwise); default the module's `defaultTurnTimeoutDays`.

aiAssistance.description: Default `off` while any seat is open or two or more people play (02 §4); fixed at creation.

email.description: An address to invite. The response never reveals whether it has an account (06 §6.1).

userId.description: A past opponent's id, from `GET /api/v1/players/recent` (06 §6.1). They are added at once (`joined`) unless AI assistance is allowed, when they get an invitation (02 §4); anyone else is `INVALID_INVITEES`.

invitees.description: At most `seats - 1` people: addresses to invite, or past opponents to add by `userId`.

joinLink.description: Create a join link for the seats left open (06 §6.8). Its URL is in the response, the only time it is shown; the game then waits for your Start.

userId.description: The player to add: a `userId` from the finished game's `canAddPlayers`.

lastPlayedAt.description: When your latest finished game together ended (ms since the epoch).

view.description: The module's `view` for your seat (null in the lobby and for invitations); its shape is the installed game's `view` schema.

via.description: How the transition was made: the app, an API token (an AI move, 02 §9.1) or the server itself (a timeout).

view.description: The module's `view` for your seat (null in the lobby and for invitations); its shape is the installed game's `view` schema.

expectedVersion.description: The game `version` the client last saw (03 §5.2).
The game `version` the client last saw (03 §5.2).
The game `version` the client last saw (03 §5.2).

playerId.description: The row to remove: a `playerId` from the lobby's `players` (creator only).

url.description: `PUBLIC_URL/join#<token>`: the token is in the fragment, so it never reaches a server log. Shown only now.

expiresAt.description: When the link stops working: 7 days from now or the lobby's expiry, whichever is first; it also ends at the start, a rotation or a revoke.

youAreIn.description: Present when you've already joined the game: open it instead of joining.

game.description: What the link shows anyone signed in who has it (06 §6.8): only the players who have joined.

token.description: The join link's fragment, as given: 22 base64url characters (anything else is `400 BAD_REQUEST`). A well-formed token that isn't a live link's is the same `404`.

get.description: Public. Answers `{ ok: true }` while the server is up. Also served unversioned at `/api/health` for load balancers and container health checks.

post.summary: Email a sign-in code
post.description: Public. Always `202 {}`, whether or not the address has an account, is rate-limited or suspended (06 §3). Only a rate-limited client IP is reported (`429`).

202.description: Accepted; a code is emailed if the address may receive one.

400.description: Invalid request or address (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a client IP is required but missing.

429.description: This client IP has made too many requests (`RATE_LIMITED`).

post.summary: Sign in with an emailed code
post.description: Public. On success, creates the account if new, sets the session cookie and answers the user. A wrong, expired, consumed or unknown code is `400 INVALID_CODE`, indistinguishably (06 §3).

200.description: Signed in; the response sets the session cookie.

schema.description: `__Host-sid=…; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=34560000` (`sid` without `Secure` in local-dev mode, 06 §4).

Set-Cookie.description: `__Host-sid=…; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=34560000` (`sid` without `Secure` in local-dev mode, 06 §4).

400.description: `INVALID_CODE` or `BAD_REQUEST`.

429.description: Too many attempts for this address or client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`).

post.summary: Sign out this session
post.description: Session only. Deletes this session and clears the cookie.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`).

post.summary: Sign out everywhere
post.description: Session only. Deletes every session of the user and clears the cookie.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`).
A session cookie and a bearer token together (`BAD_REQUEST`).

patch.summary: Change the display name or settings; confirm the age; completes onboarding
patch.description: Session only. The request that leaves both a display name and the age confirmation for the current `MIN_AGE` done completes onboarding (06 §5); they may come together or apart. After onboarding, at most 3 name changes per 30 days (`429`). `settings` changes only the keys given.

400.description: A display name breaking the rules, or an invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`).

403.description: `BAD_ORIGIN`, `SUSPENDED`, or `ONBOARDING_REQUIRED` for `emailNudges: true` while onboarding isn't done (as this request leaves it, 06 §5).

429.description: Too many writes or display-name changes (`RATE_LIMITED`).

delete.description: Session only, with a fresh `delete_account` code (06 §7). Immediate and irreversible; clears the cookie and emails a confirmation.

400.description: `INVALID_CODE` or `BAD_REQUEST`.

post.summary: Say the user is under the minimum age
post.description: Session only, and only while `needsOnboarding` is true (06 §5). An account that never completed onboarding is deleted at once with its sessions, with no step-up code; invite emails to its address stop and its pending email seats are never delivered. An onboarded account re-prompted after a `MIN_AGE` rise is only signed out of this session; nothing is deleted. Either way the cookie is cleared.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`).

409.description: Onboarding is complete for the current `MIN_AGE` (`WRONG_STATUS`).

post.summary: Email a code to delete the account
post.description: Session only. Emails a `delete_account` step-up code (06 §7).

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`).

post.summary: Save this device's push subscription
post.description: Session only. An idempotent upsert bound to the current session. An endpoint already stored for another account or session moves to this one only with the same keys, or once that session has ended; otherwise nothing changes. At most 10 per account; the least recently useful is evicted. The subscription is deleted with its session.

400.description: Invalid request, or an endpoint or keys that 08 T12 refuses (`BAD_REQUEST`).

delete.description: Session only. Removes the subscription with this endpoint if it belongs to you; otherwise does nothing.

204.description: Removed, or there was nothing of yours to remove.

400.description: Invalid request, or an endpoint or keys that 08 T12 refuses (`BAD_REQUEST`).

get.summary: The game types you can create, with their options catalog
get.description: Enabled game types only (`ENABLED_GAMES`). The module catalog sees the enabled built-in dictionaries; it never contains word-list contents, hashes or sizes.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

get.summary: A game type's rules, as Markdown
get.description: Public. From the installed manifest (02 §7.2); the latest rules version unless `version` is given.

schema.description: A rules version; default the latest.

parameters.description: A rules version; default the latest.
parameters.name: version

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`).

404.description: Unknown game type or rules version (`NOT_FOUND`).

post.summary: Create a game
post.description: Every valid address gets a seat and the same response, whatever it turns out to be (Q3). A past opponent picked by `userId` is added at once. The game starts at once (`active`) only if every seat is filled by past opponents added that way and no join link was asked for; otherwise it waits in the lobby.

400.description: `UNKNOWN_GAME`, `INVALID_OPTIONS` (`detail: { code, detail? }` with the module's code), `INVALID_SEAT_COUNT`, `INVALID_TIMEOUT`, `INVALID_INVITEES`, `CANNOT_PLAY_SELF` or `BAD_REQUEST`.

429.description: Too many games, email invitees or join links (`RATE_LIMITED`); nothing is created.

get.description: Newest activity first, 50 per page: every lobby and active game; finished games from the last 90 days; declined, cancelled and expired ones from the last 7 days.

schema.description: `true`: only your invitations; `hidden`: only hidden ones.

parameters.description: `true`: only your invitations; `hidden`: only hidden ones.
parameters.name: invitations

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

post.summary: Rematch a finished game
post.description: A player of a `finished` game asks for its rematch: the same game type, options (resolved again), turn timeout, seat order and AI setting, with every other player who acted in it and whose account still exists picked by `userId`, one seat each (`409 REMATCH_UNAVAILABLE` if that is fewer than the game's minimum), created exactly as `POST /api/v1/games` would (`201`, you are the creator). A finished game has one rematch at a time: while it is live or was played, every player's call answers `200` with it, accepting your invitation in it if you hold one; one that ended unplayed (any declined ending, or cancelled or expired before any action, never an operator's cancel) is replaced by the next call. Anyone who wasn't a player of the game, or isn't a member of its rematch any more, gets `404`. Takes no input: an empty body or `{}`.

200.description: The game's existing rematch (with your invitation accepted, if you held one).

400.description: As `POST /api/v1/games`: `UNKNOWN_GAME`, `INVALID_OPTIONS` (the stored options no longer resolve; `detail: { code, detail? }` with the module's code), `INVALID_SEAT_COUNT`, `INVALID_INVITEES` (another player can't be picked) or `BAD_REQUEST`.

404.description: No such game, you weren't a player of it, or you're no longer a member of its rematch (`NOT_FOUND`).

409.description: `WRONG_STATUS` (the game isn't `finished`, or the rematch's lobby ended meanwhile), `REMATCH_UNAVAILABLE` (too few players left for the game), `STALE_GAME` (accepting or creating it kept losing races; try again), `INVALID_SEATS` (`detail: { code, detail? }`), `TOO_MANY_GAMES` or `GAME_UNAVAILABLE`.

429.description: Too many games or game writes (`RATE_LIMITED`); nothing is created.

post.summary: Add a link joiner to your players
post.description: The creator of a `finished` game answers yes to "Add <name> to your players?" for someone in its `canAddPlayers`: you and that player become past opponents (both ways, never the other players), so either of you can pick the other for a game or a rematch. Not a transition: the game's `version` is unchanged. `204` also when repeated, and when the pair isn't written (a block between you either way, or an account suspended or being deleted), which writes nothing and answers the same, so the answer never says whether, or why (06 §6.9, §6.11).

204.description: Answered: added, already added, or a silent no-op.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

403.description: `BAD_ORIGIN`, `ONBOARDING_REQUIRED` (onboarding incomplete, or a re-prompt after a `MIN_AGE` rise, 06 §5) or `SUSPENDED`.

404.description: No such game, you're not its creator, it isn't `finished`, or that player didn't join it through a link and act in it (`NOT_FOUND`, the same in every case).

get.summary: Your past opponents, to pick for a new game
get.description: People you've finished a game with, both having acted (04 `past_opponents`), newest first, at most 50, across all game types; never anyone with a block between you either way (06 §6.9).

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

get.summary: A game and your view of it
get.description: `view` is the module's view for your seat while active, null in the lobby, and your own final view after a started game ends.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

get.description: Oldest first, 100 per page. Empty for games that never started.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

post.summary: Make a move
post.description: Checks in order: membership with a seat (`404`), `active` (`409 GAME_NOT_ACTIVE`, `GAME_UNAVAILABLE`), `expectedVersion` (`409 STALE_GAME`), your turn (`409 NOT_YOUR_TURN`), the action schema (`400 INVALID_ACTION`), then the module's `validate` (`400` with its `{ code, detail }`).

400.description: `INVALID_ACTION`, a module error code with its detail, or `BAD_REQUEST`.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

post.summary: Preview a move without making it
post.description: Runs the membership, status, turn and schema checks of `/actions`, then the module's `preview`. `404` also for a game type without previews.

400.description: `INVALID_ACTION`, a module error code with its detail, or `BAD_REQUEST`.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

post.summary: Start a game from the lobby
post.description: Creator only, with at least the minimum number of seats joined. Unfilled seats are dropped.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

409.description: `STALE_GAME`, `WRONG_STATUS`, `NOT_ENOUGH_PLAYERS`, `INVALID_SEATS` (`detail: { code, detail? }`) or `GAME_UNAVAILABLE` (this build no longer has the game's engine).

post.summary: Accept an invitation
post.description: The holder of an invitation, in the lobby. The game starts by itself once every seat is joined.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

409.description: `STALE_GAME`, `WRONG_STATUS` or `GAME_UNAVAILABLE` (this build no longer has the game's engine).

post.summary: Decline an invitation or a game you haven't acted in
post.description: An invited or joined player other than the creator, in the lobby (`204`: you are no longer a member); or any playing seat before its first action (`200`). Never a loss: too few players left ends the game `declined` with no ranking.

204.description: Done; you are no longer a member of the game.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

403.description: `NOT_ALLOWED` (the creator in the lobby: cancel instead), `BAD_ORIGIN` or `SUSPENDED`.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

409.description: `STALE_GAME`, `ALREADY_ACTED`, `WRONG_STATUS` or `GAME_UNAVAILABLE` (this build no longer has the game's engine).

post.summary: Resign
post.description: Any playing seat of an active game. A resignation is a loss.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

409.description: `STALE_GAME`, `WRONG_STATUS` or `GAME_UNAVAILABLE` (this build no longer has the game's engine).

post.summary: Cancel a game in the lobby
post.description: Creator only, in the lobby.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

409.description: `STALE_GAME`, `WRONG_STATUS` or `GAME_UNAVAILABLE` (this build no longer has the game's engine).

post.summary: Remove a player from the lobby
post.description: Creator only, in the lobby: an invited or joined row of this game, never your own, becomes `removed` (a typed address is cleared). A remove never ends the lobby, and the person removed can't come back into this game through any join link, a rotated or new one included (06 §6.8).

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

404.description: No such game, you're not a member of it, or no such seat to remove in it (`NOT_FOUND`).

409.description: `STALE_GAME`, `WRONG_STATUS` or `GAME_UNAVAILABLE` (this build no longer has the game's engine).

post.summary: Create or rotate the lobby's join link
post.description: Creator only, in the lobby. Replaces any link the game has (the old one stops working; nobody removed from the lobby, or who declined, comes back through any link). Anyone signed in with the link sees the game type, options and the joined players' names, and can take an open seat; the game then waits for your Start. Changes no game state, so the game's `version` stays the same. Takes no input: an empty body or `{}`.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

403.description: `NOT_ALLOWED` (not the creator), `ONBOARDING_REQUIRED` (onboarding incomplete, or a re-prompt after a `MIN_AGE` rise, 06 §5), `BAD_ORIGIN` or `SUSPENDED`.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

delete.description: Creator only. The link stops working at once; nobody who joined through it is removed, and the lobby never ends because of it. `204` also when there is no live link.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).

post.summary: See the game a join link is for
post.description: Nothing is joined: joining needs `POST /api/v1/join`. Counts toward your join-link limits, as a join does.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), a cookie and a bearer token together, or no client address on a proxied deployment.

404.description: The link doesn't work for you: unknown, revoked, rotated or expired; the game is full or has started; a block between you and someone in it; you declined or left it, or the creator removed you (`NOT_FOUND`, the same in every case).

429.description: Too many join-link lookups and joins from you or your network (`RATE_LIMITED`).

post.summary: Join a game through its join link
post.description: Takes an open seat, or accepts the invitation you already hold in the game. Never starts the game: its creator does. Retried on the server when another change to the game wins a race.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), a cookie and a bearer token together, or no client address on a proxied deployment.

404.description: The link doesn't work for you: unknown, revoked, rotated or expired; the game is full or has started; a block between you and someone in it; you declined or left it, or the creator removed you (`NOT_FOUND`, the same in every case).

409.description: `ALREADY_JOINED`, `STALE_GAME` (every retry lost a race; try again) or `GAME_UNAVAILABLE`.

429.description: Too many join-link lookups and joins from you or your network (`RATE_LIMITED`).

post.summary: Mark a game's activity as read
post.description: Not a transition: it changes only your own unread marker.

400.description: Invalid request (`BAD_REQUEST`), or a cookie and a bearer token together.

404.description: No such game, or you're not a member of it (`NOT_FOUND`).
